title: System
comment: The engine's own column, merged into every game. It is a module and not a game: no players, no phases, nothing that would collide with the file including it. Its zone sits at x 1.0, which is where the board ends — a game keeps the whole of its own 0-1 space and the window is drawn a little wider than the game.

cards.tooltip: Keep this position. *Continue*, on the title screen, picks it up again. There is one save, so saving writes over the last one.
Back to the title screen. Save first if you want this game back.
cards.comment: Play asks; the ability is what a Yes runs. Any button that should ask first is written the same way.

cards.comment: The answer to any button whose play is options:sys_yes,sys_no. A pick is played against the card that asked, so this runs that card's abilities.
